limitations: Select the green-methanol baseline only; biomass and reverse-Boudouard sections are outside the first case.

Supporting information read 2026-11-13 (from Europe PMC's supplementary files of PMC12093377): life-cycle inventories, heat-exchanger stream lists (Tables S13-S15) and costs; no stream table. Not usable for a stream-by-stream comparison.

sources.use: Second ethyl acetate plant (conventional set-up): cases/ethyl-acetate-sulgan-2020, transcribed and audited 2026-11-13; recommended replacement for process 3 in docs/NEXT_PLANTS.md (to decide).
limitations: Uses NRTL-HOC and rate-based packed columns; CHEPTA's NRTL with a dimerizing ideal vapour and equilibrium stages are a different model.
NRTL-HOC parameters (Aspen databank) and the sulfuric acid concentration are not printed; the units of the activation energy are not stated.
Same process family as piotrowski-kubica-2021: keep both in one split group.
Reactive-distillation variants are later work.
sources.next_action: Build CHEPTA requests from cases/ethyl-acetate-sulgan-2020 and run the conventional plant unit by unit, then whole.

sources.use: Industrial reactor extension and tests of model applicability.
limitations: Microkinetic network and transport analysis differ from Aali–Hadi's two-reaction model.
The plant diagram is context; it is not proof that all downstream column specifications are supplied.
C3+ products cannot be silently omitted or replaced.
Read 2026-11-13: no stream table and no separation units simulated; not usable as a complete plant (docs/NEXT_PLANTS.md).
sources.next_action: Inventory the complete reaction network, species, catalyst assumptions and transport requirements before choosing a reproducible subset.

sources.title: The ChemSep Book, second edition
sources.license: Public domain according to CHEPTA's record ('This publication is public domain', p. 2 of the PDF, read by CHEPTA 2026-10-29); not checked by Lab
locators: Section 1.2, pp. 9-17 (column set-up: 1.1 atm, 11.7471 mol/s equimolar saturated liquid on stage 5 of 10, reflux ratio 2, bottoms 5.874 mol/s); section 1.3, pp. 18-20: Figure 1.18 (balances), Figure 1.19 (T, P, flows), Figure 1.20 (x, y, K of benzene), Figure 1.21 (stream table); all as transcribed in CHEPTA v0.6.0 validation/data/columns/B2-chemsep-benzene-toluene.json
sources.use: Published worked example of a benzene + toluene column; the numbers are the authors' simulation (UNIFAC with Antoine vapour pressures, constant molar overflow), not measurements. Used by cases/benzene-toluene-chemsep-b2.
limitations: Lab has not opened the book: every number is CHEPTA's transcription of its figures.
The published profile is another simulator's result with another property method; agreement is between two models, not with experiment.
CHEPTA's record gives the copy as http://; the https form here is assumed and was not fetched.
sources.next_action: The maintainer checks the transcribed set-up and Figures 1.19 to 1.21 against the book and confirms the public-domain statement.
